results.name: Camera preferences reject invalid fields, clamp limits and keep defaults
Short right click with small jitter remains a click and does not pan
Long stationary right hold consumes release without moving the camera
Fast deliberate drag promotes before the hold timer elapses
Grab moves the projected ground by the exact CSS pointer displacement
Many pointer moves add up without repeatedly applying the same delta
Drag sensitivity and inverted grab direction apply exactly once
Disabling right dragging restores stationary long-click behavior
Middle drag is immediate even with right dragging disabled
Left selection gestures suppress keys and edges without panning
Continuous-scroll mode keeps moving while pointer stays displaced
Continuous scroll dead zone stops, and releasing adds no drift
Edge scroll respects dwell delay and strength at the playable boundary
HUD hover, outside coordinates and disabled edge scroll do not pan
Fullscreen-only edge setting is enforced
Bottom edge is actionable with a point just inside the canvas
Diagonal keyboard speed is normalized and Shift accelerates
Camera travel is frame-rate independent at 30 and 120 updates per second
Smooth start still stops immediately when the direction is released
Ground under the mouse stays anchored throughout smooth zoom
Center zoom option does not move the camera target
Wheel pixel, line and page modes convert to the same intended distance
Rapid wheel bursts respect zoom and map boundaries
Blur/modal cancellation releases gesture and pending wheel animation
Focus and reset zoom cancel pending motion and sync picking matrices
Camera clamps target at world boundaries without NaN
Current and original v0.3.0 save fixtures load and resave as the current release

environment: Node.js v22.16.0. Camera math and input state, not physical mouse/GPU performance.
